title: Rack Slot Range Labels
brief: A datacentre dashboard lists the free slots in a rack by number. Long lists are hard to read, so the dashboard compresses each unbroken run of slot numbers into one label: a lone slot is shown as its number, such as 7, and a run of two or more is shown as its first and last number joined by ->, such as 4->5.
Implement labelSlotRuns(nums), where nums is the list of free slot numbers in increasing order, and return the list of labels as strings covering every number in nums.
